title: Test 1 · Exam Practice · Reading Part 2
instructions: Questions 6–10. Match five students with the most suitable art course (A–H). Three courses are not used.

context.title: Get Artistic
context.description: Teachers here always have ideas to get you drawing, painting and printing – but you can use your own material, too. The studio-based course focuses on portraits – you’ll learn how to develop whatever you’ve brought, or use famous portraits, to create pictures of people. One-to-one sessions also available.

context.title: Art Attack!
context.description: Learn how to create pictures, perhaps based on your own writing, to put into a short book or poster, using simple techniques that don’t require technology. Discover, too, how to put a book together, with a professional-looking cover designed and hand-printed by you. Perfect for anyone considering further studies in art.

context.title: Art and imagination
context.description: If you like designing clothes, you’ll enjoy learning to use special computer software here to create and print out designs for tops, shoes and hats that people would love to wear! You’ll go home with a folder of work, perfect to present when applying for a higher-level art course. Individual classes also available.

context.title: Create!
context.description: Draw and paint in different situations – in the studio or even in the park! Gallery visits are also included, and you’re taught how to base your work on studies of landscapes and portraits by well-known artists. Teachers also encourage you to experiment with various styles and methods.

context.title: More Art Now!
context.description: Improve how you paint people and places on this studio-based course. The teachers bring in work, ranging from photos to posters, to give you ideas. And use the studio website to show your work and exchange ideas with other students – useful for anyone wishing to study art at a higher level.

context.title: Art Workshop
context.description: Do some drawings, in the studio or outside, or bring along your own. The teachers will then help you to turn them into wonderful printed designs, using simple methods you can try yourself after the course. You’ll then transfer your designs onto cotton and silk, using special paints – perfect to use in sewing projects afterwards.

context.title: Do it yourself
context.description: Try making art to go with your stories here – working inside or outside! You’ll get ideas from books showing famous paintings and cartoons, and then create and print pictures of people to accompany your stories, using digital design techniques. There’s even one-to-one teaching if you’d prefer.

context.title: The Studio
context.description: Come and experiment with digital design. You’ll get great ideas through research, then using special software, create your pictures and add details on screen, whether it’s clothes, people, books or something to put on the wall. Upload your work on the studio website and get opinions from your classmates there – and comment on theirs!

questions.source: Rafa wants to produce artwork to support his art college application. He’s written stories, which he’d like to publish, and wants to learn how to include drawings in them, without using a computer.
questions.ask: Which option (A–H) is the most suitable?
questions.explanationVi: Rafa cần minh họa truyện bằng cách thủ công và chuẩn bị hồ sơ học nghệ thuật. B hướng dẫn làm hình minh họa dựa trên bài viết, không cần công nghệ, đồng thời phù hợp cho người học lên bậc cao hơn.

questions.source: Simona enjoys creating art on her computer, and wants to find ways to improve the posters she makes on it. She also wants to share what she’s done with other students on the course.
questions.ask: Which option (A–H) is the most suitable?
questions.explanationVi: H dùng phần mềm thiết kế để tạo và chỉnh sửa hình trên màn hình, sau đó đăng bài lên website để các bạn cùng lớp nhận xét, đúng cả hai nhu cầu của Simona.

questions.source: Andrei wants to try different painting techniques, and have trips to see the work of famous painters, to get ideas for his own pictures. He’d also like to try painting outdoors.
questions.ask: Which option (A–H) is the most suitable?
questions.explanationVi: D dạy vẽ trong công viên, đưa học viên tham quan phòng tranh và khuyến khích thử nhiều phong cách, kỹ thuật mới.

questions.source: Nicola enjoys printing by hand. She wants to print the patterns she’s created onto different materials, for her mother to make into clothes, and also learn basic printing techniques to use at home.
questions.ask: Which option (A–H) is the most suitable?
questions.explanationVi: F tập trung vào cách in thủ công đơn giản và chuyển mẫu in lên vải cotton hoặc lụa để sử dụng trong các sản phẩm may mặc.

questions.source: Karl enjoys taking photos of his family, and wants to use them as a basis for the art he produces. He’d like to go somewhere that also offers private lessons.
questions.ask: Which option (A–H) is the most suitable?
questions.explanationVi: A tập trung vào chân dung, cho phép mang ảnh hoặc tài liệu của mình đến để phát triển thành tranh và có các buổi học một kèm một.
